versions.changelog:
Initial release: provides founders with actionable strategies to optimize their products for recommendations by major AI assistants.

- Guides users through a set of discovery questions to tailor LLM SEO advice.
- Delivers clear audit steps, content strategy, citation building, technical optimizations, monitoring, and an action plan.
- Offers prioritized checklists and further reading for comprehensive AI search optimization (AEO/GEO).
- Focuses on visibility, relevance, and credibility to influence generative AI results across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini.
